summary: Frontend-only verification of the Phase Pi+3 marketing image fix. Independently validated with Playwright against the deployed preview URL. All 8 previously missing images now render as real photos/renders (naturalWidth=1024) on Landing (/), /for-business and /for-advertisers. Party Mix station card renders via the Tigris fallback CDN (302 -> presigned Tigris URL) and its naturalWidth=1024 confirms the browser followed the redirect and painted the final asset. Zero image 404s across the tracked static paths.
critical_code_review_comments: useMarketingAssets caches at module scope with a single global _cache/_resolved; fine for prod but means test harnesses cannot force a refresh without full reload -- acceptable trade-off.

PartnerSection in Landing.jsx and Features in ForBusiness.jsx duplicate the same 'imgUrl + gradient scrim + icon badge' pattern (>20 lines each). Consider extracting a shared <ImageTile> component to satisfy DRY (per code review guidelines: duplicate blocks >10 lines).
onError handlers only hide the broken but do not surface a placeholder icon in the marketing tiles (Landing stations DO handle this). Minor polish -- not a bug since all assets resolve today.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright at https://mobile-games-v2.preview.emergentagent.com. Landing / renders: 4 station covers (bollywood_mehfil.webp 200, party_dubai.webp 302->Tigris final=200, vip_lounge.webp 200, late_night_drive.webp 200); 6 partner cards with data-testid partner-card-{live_trivia,game_campaigns,coupon_wallet,audio_ads,sponsored_games,route_based_ads} each containing partner-card-img-<key> (naturalWidth=1024 confirmed); mobile preview data-testid=landing-mobile-preview-img loaded mobile_hero.png (naturalWidth=1024). /for-business renders feature-card-{live_trivia,game_campaigns,coupon_wallet} with feature-card-img-<key>. /for-advertisers renders feature-card-{audio_ads,sponsored_games,route_based_ads} with feature-card-img-<key>. All 7 /api/static/landing_images/*.png responded 200. All 4 /api/static/channel_thumbnails/*.webp responded 200 except party_dubai.webp which correctly 302's to Tigris (final image painted). Original user complaint (missing images) is resolved.
party_dubai_tigris_fallback: Confirmed: /api/static/channel_thumbnails/party_dubai.webp returned HTTP 302 in the network log; the onscreen has naturalWidth=1024 proving the browser followed the redirect to the Tigris presigned URL and rendered the asset. Backend Tigris fallback CDN is operational.
test_credentials: Not needed -- all tested surfaces are unauthenticated marketing routes.
